result: Intermittent long-playback discrepancy not reproduced; no supported production fix identified. Keep synchronization concern open.

measurementReview.oldFrameFormula: (Studio global frame - shot.from - 30) / 60, compared with audio.currentTime; formula matches the current complete-audio Sequence origin.
oldLimits: Original 100ms interval was nominal; actual timestamps were absent. 35 consecutive samples does not establish exactly 3.5 seconds.
Detailed media-event capture began at frame 36556, after SP35. Earlier engine seeking/waiting cannot be ruled out.
The old mode description saying no seek means no operator seek during the first traversal; it does not prove absence of internal engine correction.
Reaching WAV duration/ended does not by itself prove no internal playback seek occurred.
Caption-match samples compared DOM captions to timeline frames, not directly to the media clock.
measurementReview.newMethod: Record performance.now, before/after frame values, currentTime, rate, ready/paused/seeking state on DOM frame commits and at 100ms intervals. Capture media events and long tasks from before playback. Disable loop. Seek only while paused to SP33 start, then play SP33–SP36 completely at 1x and pause after the full window.

installedPlayerBehavior.behavior: Deviation above the configured tolerance can trigger seek-due-to-shift; default tolerance does not certify educational synchronization. No tolerance or playback setting was changed.
installedPlayerBehavior.fixNotApplied: Reducing tolerance would introduce more corrective seeks and does not repair measured word timing; no rate change, crop, fabricated time, or silent reclassification was performed.

impactOnOriginalRun.meaning: At seven recorded instants, the frame-driven displayed clause differed from the clause mapped to the observed audio time. This is evidence of potential preview subtitle lead, not a listening conclusion or proof of exported-video failure.

longTasks.conclusion: Long tasks were observed in this successful window, but no evidence connects them causally to the original SP35 lag.

remaining.reason: Original critical-period media events and actual sample timestamps are unavailable; adjacent-window replay did not reproduce the long-run lag. A deterministic source/timeline defect is not established.
remaining.nextEvidence: If the lag recurs during long playback, capture frame/media clocks and media events from the start, with loop disabled, before choosing a remedy. Final exported-video acceptance still requires the user-provided artifact.
